name: DEAD DAYS
source:
Live, die, live again.

A few people awoke in an unknown place.
All of them, strangers to each other, are supposed to be dead.

Amid their confusion, a mysterious entity offers to extend their life with a single, non-negotiable condition: they must eradicate various specters in this world. Only the resurrected, such as themselves, could perceive and eliminate these otherwise imperceptible apparitions.

Their revival, however, has its side effects; an abnormally strong libido, the persistent dread of an unpredictable call to battle, and the constant terror of their borrowed time running out.

Still followed by the clutches of death, their cruel daily existence was about to begin...

[Based on [url=http://clockup.net/dd/story.html]the official site[/url] and [url=https://mangagamer.org/deaddays/]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
生，死，再活。

几个人在一个不知名的地方醒来。
他们所有人，彼此素不相识，都应该死了。

在他们的困惑中，一个神秘的实体提出要延长他们的生命，并提出一个不容谈判的条件：他们必须消灭这个世界上的各种幽灵。只有复活的人，比如他们自己，才能感知并消除这些原本难以察觉的幽灵。

然而，它们的复兴也有其副作用。异常强烈的性欲，对不可预测的战斗召唤的持续恐惧，以及对借来的时间即将耗尽的持续恐惧。

死亡的魔爪依然紧随其后，他们残酷的日常生活即将开始……
